archetypes.name: delta-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Stage and lint delta filtering now rejects stale whole-tree fallbacks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stage-path and lint-fix delta boundaries. Check that missing baselines, since-committed post-head handling, reported lint paths, and reverted lint paths cannot include unrelated dirty work while preserving valid full and head-untracked snapshots. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cleanup-regression
archetypes.rationale: A full-snapshot cleanup verification regression was added without cleanup code changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new cleanup verification coverage. Confirm it exercises the full snapshot branch, uses a path-specific mismatch, stops coder fallback, and does not mask staged residue or rely on a blanket verification failure. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
